title: Logistic regression with Pólya–Gamma augmentation
text: target model P(y=1∣x)=logit−1(x′β)P(y = 1 \mid x) = \text{logit}^{-1}(x'\beta). contaminated units, M0/Mjoint use Bernoulli(qq) density q∼Beta(1,1)q \sim \text{Beta}(1, 1), M1 rival logistic regression. coefficient update uses Pólya–Gamma data augmentation (Polson, Scott Windle, 2013): conditional ωi∼PG(1,xi′β)\omega_i \sim PG(1, x_i'\beta), posterior β\beta Gaussian covariance V=(X′ΩX+B0−1)−1V = (X'\Omega X + B_0^{-1})^{-1} mean VX′(y−1/2)V X'(y - 1/2). original implementation, PG(1,z)PG(1, z) variables drawn first KK terms (mixture_control(pg_terms = 128)) sum--gammas representation plus correction mean omitted tail — accurate approximation rather exact draw. Binary outcomes carry little information per unit, contaminating mechanism must differ substantially (e.g. sign-flipped effects) bias logistic fit, identifying individual contaminated units relies heavily covariate term Mjoint.

NP points far P covariate distribution (Mahalanobis distance) thereby likely flagged. "M1" rival regression family coefficients \(\beta_{bad}\) (variance, Gaussian case); covariate term. title: Contamination-aware Bayesian integration of probability and non-probability samples — mixture_fit
text: data-augmentation Gibbs sampler alternates (1) drawing every \(z_j\) Bernoulli full conditional, (2) drawing \(\pi \sim Beta(a_\pi + \sum z_j, b_\pi + n_{NP} - \sum z_j)\), (3) updating target-model parameters given P sample plus NP units \(z_j = 1\), (4) updating contaminating component given units \(z_j = 0\). Step (3) family specific follows original implementation: Gaussian: conjugate normal / inverse-gamma Gibbs updates. Binomial: Polya-Gamma augmentation (Polson, Scott Windle, 2013), PG(1, z) variables drawn pg_terms-term truncation sum--gammas representation plus tail-mean correction. close approximation rather exact PG draw. Poisson: Metropolis-Hastings step Laplace (Gaussian) proposal centred conditional mode, found irls_steps Newton iterations current value. iterations converged proposal state independent step exact independence sampler; otherwise approximation. post-burn-acceptance rate reported summary.bsm_fit(). filter score NP unit \(j\) Rao-Blackwellised posterior probability compatibility, \(s_j = E[P(z_j = 1 \mid \cdot) \mid data]\), averaged post-burn-iterations (thinning affects stored parameter draws).
